title: Harness team run checkpoint (state.yaml)
description: FEAT-104: the closed schema for schema_version 2 and later run checkpoints. check-domain.sh enforces it at write time and check-state.sh sweeps it at rest.

schema_version.description: Read by check-domain.sh and check-state.sh to select closed-schema enforcement; version 2 is the first enforced version.

run_id.description: Read by check-domain.sh to bind an update to the run directory it replaces.

run_uid.description: Minted and read by the Harness write path to preserve one run identity across updates.

feature.description: Read by team leads and state checks as the owning feature identifier.

squad.description: Read by the orchestrator and feature.json run roll-up as the executing squad.

host.description: Read by the Harness team loop as the lead persona that owns the run.

status.description: Read by the Harness team loop to resume or terminate the run.

steps.description: Read by the Harness team loop as the durable execution DAG.

id.description: Read by the lead and orchestrator as the stable step identifier.

persona.description: Read by the lead to select the member persona for dispatch.

task.description: Read by the lead to bind the dispatch to a plan task identifier.

seq.description: Read by the lead as the step sequence marker.

depends_on.description: Read by the lead to compute the ready set.

outputs.description: Read by the lead to declare paths the step is expected to produce.

mutates_repo.description: Read by the lead to determine whether concurrent dispatch is safe.

on_fail.description: Read by the lead to choose the configured failure route.

status.description: Read by the lead to determine whether the step is pending, active, or terminal.

verdict.description: Read by the lead to reconcile the member result.

lead_verdict.description: Read by the orchestrator as the lead's assessed step verdict.

cycles.description: Read by the lead as the number of rework cycles consumed.

max_cycles.description: Read by the lead as the step's rework ceiling.

redispatches.description: Read by the lead as the total redispatch count.

dispatched_at.description: Read by the lead as the first dispatch sequence marker.

completed_at.description: Read by the lead as the first completion sequence marker.

redispatched_at.description: Read by the lead as the latest redispatch sequence marker.

recompleted_at.description: Read by the lead as the latest recompletion sequence marker.

routed_by.description: Read by the orchestrator to identify the routing authority.

note.description: Read by a fresh lead as the one-line checkpoint summary ceiling.

artifact.description: Read by the lead and successor as the member artifact pointer.

evidence.description: Read by a fresh lead as matchable, per-dispatch facts that do not belong in the closed step vocabulary.

cycles_used.description: Read by the orchestrator as the run-level rework count.

cost.description: Historical-only checkpoint key retained because check-state.sh still recognizes pre-FEAT-08 runs.

flow.description: Read by the resuming lead as a matchable flow identifier.

task.description: Read by the resuming lead as a run-level plan task identifier.

team.description: Read by the resuming lead as a matchable team identifier.

branch.description: Read by review and build flows as the feature branch marker.

worktree.description: Read by review and build flows as the feature checkout path.

review_sha.description: Read by validation flows as the pinned review commit.

pinned_sha.description: Read by validation flows as an immutable target commit.

base_sha.description: Read by diff-based flows as the comparison base commit.

head_sha.description: Read by diff-based flows as the comparison head commit.

tip_sha.description: Read by reconciliation flows as the observed branch tip.

commits.description: Read by reconciliation flows as the ordered commit identifiers.

verdict.description: Read by the orchestrator as the run roll-up verdict.

severity_max.description: Read by validation flows as the run's maximum finding severity.

digest.description: Read by successors as the run digest artifact pointer.
